sahneler.metin: Three nuclear reactors at Fukushima melted down.
Within days, hydrogen explosions destroyed reactor buildings.
The reactors had already shut down safely.
Then a tsunami poured over the seawall.
It flooded the backup generators and electrical rooms.
Without power, the cooling pumps stopped.
Plants worldwide then added flood protection and mobile backup power.

aciklama:
Fukushima suffered three reactor meltdowns. The cause: station blackout from flooded emergency diesel generators and switchgear, causing loss of cooling.
